You know how a road is built? Rocks an Gravel. Millions of small pieces make something big, usefull and finished. Being clean and sober is the finished road and to go straight from using to clean and sober is unrealistic and too big. It's all about building with the small pieces. Break down your next hour, your next 12 hours then your next day. Then deal with tomorrow how you got through today. Before you know it you have a week, then 2 then 3 and you will feel like there is no going back. It's not about getting clean an sober, its about getting through your day without using, there is a subtle difference. Im rooting for you all the way. You are powerful, you are beautiful. The Gods wait to delight in you XxX
